# Dean Palermo

> Dean Palermo is an executive producer, digital strategist, creative producer, AI production director, and founder of Elettro Incorporated. He is based in Davie, Florida and has more than 25 years of experience in digital production, marketing, web development, content, music, and emerging technology.

## Core Expertise

- Executive production and digital strategy
- Website design and development
- SEO and AI search optimization
- Google Ads and performance marketing
- AI content production and workflow automation
- Social media strategy and platform-native content
- Music production, artist branding, and global distribution
- Product architecture, CMS development, analytics, and ecommerce
- Project operations, creative leadership, and multi-market production

## Current Work

### Elettro Incorporated

Dean Palermo is the founder and executive producer of Elettro, a full-service creative production and digital agency. Elettro builds websites, improves SEO and AI-search readiness, manages Google Ads, produces content, and develops automation systems.

- [Elettro.com](https://elettro.com/)
- [AIO Authority](https://aioauthority.com/)

### Stashbox Radio

Dean designed and built Stashbox Radio as a custom music, video, merchandise, advertising, CMS, and analytics platform. The system includes a public player, song administration, visual experiences, listener engagement tracking, advertising controls, product placement, PostgreSQL data, AWS services, and a development-to-production workflow.

- [Stashbox Radio](https://stashbox.com/radio/)
- [Stashbox Radio Project Report](https://stashbox.com/radio/report/)

### Stashbox

Dean is the founder and executive producer of Stashbox. The project includes original music, global distribution, artist branding, video, social growth, and ecommerce.

- [Stashbox](https://stashbox.com/)
- [Stashbox YouTube](https://youtube.com/@stashboxband)
- [Stashbox on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0QMZNPEj7A2MFnT9zJGERa)
- [Stashbox.ai](https://stashbox.ai/)

## Selected Experience

- Senior Global Organic Social Project Manager at Audible and Amazon
- Managed major international content programs across 10 markets
- Led high-profile entertainment, publishing, political, music, and cultural productions
- Produced award-winning digital work for media, hospitality, consumer, nonprofit, legal, healthcare, sports, and technology organizations
- Past recognition includes Webby nominations and a Promax Award
- Built and operated digital products and campaigns generating more than one billion video views
